steps.name: party-menu
steps.probe: (async () => { const c = await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js'); return { m: c.mount(), cursor: c.cursorAt(40, 100), list: c.rc(40, 100) }; })()

steps.name: explore
steps.probe: (c => ({ pos: c.pos(), cursor: c.cursorAt(68, 68), list: c.rc(68, 68) }))(await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js'))

steps.name: original-mode
steps.probe: (async () => { const c = await import('/test/plus/click-probe.js'); const { hooks } = await import('/plus/hooks.js'); hooks.enabled = false; const r = { list: c.rc(68, 68), cursor: c.cursorAt(68, 68) }; hooks.enabled = true; return r; })()
